description: Run Native Android Gradle tests or Flutter tests. Native unit runs test<Variant>UnitTest and instrumented runs connected<Variant>AndroidTest. Flutter unit runs flutter test (unit + widget tests); Flutter instrumented runs flutter test -d <device-id> integration_test when integration_test/ exists.

extraArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to Gradle or flutter test.

kind.description: Defaults to instrumented for native Android; unit runs Flutter unit/widget tests without a device.

projectPath.description: Gradle root or Flutter package root; Flutter monorepos should pass the package path explicitly if multiple apps exist.

name: test_device
title: Test (Device)
